newsitem.title: USA: Genome Therapeutics H. pylori pact renewed.
newsitem.headline: Genome Therapeutics H. pylori pact renewed.

text.p: Genome Therapeutics Corp and Astra Research Center Boston said Monday they agreed to extend their existing alliance to identify and develop novel anti-infectives and vaccines to treat Helicobacter pylori.
The expanded agreement will carry the alliance at least through September 1998. Financial terms were not disclosed.

H. pylori is linked with peptic ulcers and stomach cancers. Some 500,000 Americans develop ulcers yearly, and $7 billion is spent on treating ulcers worldwide, according to a press release issued by the companies.
